atoms.proposition: Australian Red Cross provided support to people in Australia and on the ground in Israel and the Occupied Palestinian Territories in response to the conflict escalation in October 2023.
qualifications: The source specifies October 2023 but not an exact day.

candidates.statement: Australian Red Cross provides humanitarian assistance to people affected by international conflicts and disasters, in Australia and overseas, and supports partner Red Cross and Red Crescent National Societies through funding, technical expertise, delegate deployments, relief supplies, and advocacy for international humanitarian law.

In response to the conflict escalation in October 2023, Australian Red Cross provided support to people in Australia and on the ground in Israel and the Occupied Palestinian Territories; supported repatriation to New South Wales and Western Australia; provided cash assistance to people from Israel and the Occupied Palestinian Territories on temporary visas experiencing financial hardship; mobilised over $4 million for ICRC and IFRC work in Israel, the Occupied Palestinian Territories, Egypt, and Lebanon; deployed 12 delegates; and helped establish and staff a 60-bed ICRC field hospital in Rafah, Gaza.

In response to the conflict escalation in October 2023, Australian Red Cross supported people in Australia and on the ground in Israel and the Occupied Palestinian Territories, assisted repatriation and cash support, mobilised over $4 million for ICRC and IFRC operations, deployed 12 delegates, and engaged in confidential dialogue with the Australian Government on humanitarian impacts and international humanitarian law.
